---
title: "MEC1019: Sustainable Processes"
subtitle: "Design project"
---

This course builds up, step by step, the electronics and programming needed
for the design project: controlling a circuit with an Arduino microcontroller
and switching between power sources with relays.

## Materials

| Part | Topic | Slides |
|------|-------|--------|
| 1 | Arduino basics, LEDs, digital signals, `for` loops | [PDF](materials/microcontrollers-part-1.pdf) |
| 2 | `analogWrite`, voltage resolution, Ohm's law | [PDF](materials/microcontrollers-part-2.pdf) |
| 3 | Loops, `if` statements, buzzer alarm, PWM | [PDF](materials/microcontrollers-part-3.pdf) |
| 5 | Voltage dividers | [PDF](materials/microcontrollers-part-5-voltage-dividers0.pdf) |
| 6 | Potentiometers | [PDF](materials/microcontrollers-part-6-potentiometers.pdf) |
| 7 | Relays | [PDF](materials/microcontrollers-part-7.pdf) |
| 8 | Wiring the finished circuit (RES + battery via relay) | [PDF](materials/microcontrollers-part-8.pdf) |
| — | Finished circuit | [PowerPoint](materials/finished-circuit.pptx) |

See the [Microcontrollers](microcontrollers.qmd) page for a summary of each
part with the slides embedded.

::: {.callout-note}
Materials are pulled automatically from the
